Message:
cxgb4: Add PHY firmware support for T420-BT cards

Add support for flashing 10GBaseT adapter with BCM 84834 PHY and
Aquantia AQ1202 PHY.

Updating of the PHY firmware must happen before the INITIALIZE_CMD.
